text:
jane_docs: Heads-up — opened a small PR to add an SDK example for the new metering header (X-Redwood-Burst-Credits) and clarify our tiering docs. Can someone from eng + analytics glance?

sam_eng: Saw it, will take a look after standup. Quick question — is the header optional or enforced at the gateway?

jane_docs: Optional for now. We want examples for both cases (client sets preferred burst credits, gateway may honor or cap). PR includes both snippets.

morgan_pm: FYI product decided on wording: "burst credits" not "burst tokens" — tiny copy nit. Also we need a short blurb in the billing FAQ about how burst credits interact with reserved capacity.

jane_docs: Good call, I'll update copy in the FAQ section and the migration guide.

lee_se: Analytics team — the dashboard panel that shows "tokens per minute" should be split by tier. Can you add a legend for tier attribution? Link in PR points to current panel: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/usage-panel

analytics_bot: Noted — I'll open a dashboard patch and reference the PR. ETA EOD.

sam_eng: Quick code snippet suggestion for SDK v2 (PUT header example):

```http
POST /v2/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
X-Redwood-Burst-Credits: 150
Content-Type: application/json

{ "model": "open-llama-70b", "input": "summarize..." }
```

jane_docs: Perfect, I'll add that verbatim and include a small note about server-side capping and how it shows up in usage analytics ("capped" flag in metering events).

morgan_pm: Also add a migration paragraph for customers using Dedicated — they need to set a policy in the pool config to enable honor/ignore of client-supplied burst headers.

jane_docs: Will do. @lee_se — can you confirm the event field name we should document? I used `burst_credits_applied` in the PR but happy to change.

lee_se: `burst_credits_applied` is fine. We'll emit `burst_credits_requested` and `burst_credits_applied` in metering events.

docs-bot: PR 4728 added — docs/guide/billing/metering-burst-headers.md (WIP). Assigned: jane_docs. Reviewers: sam_eng, lee_se.

jane_docs: Thanks — tagging here so reviewers get a quick context thread. If there's nothing major I'll merge after the dashboard patch lands.

sam_eng: Quick nit: add an example showing SDK retry behavior when request is capped, e.g., 429 with `x-retry-after-ms`.

jane_docs: Good call, adding that now.

morgan_pm: ETA for merge?

jane_docs: If reviews come back by noon, merge today. Otherwise Monday AM.

lee_se: Dashboard patch created, referenced in PR comments.

jane_docs: Amazing — thanks everyone. Closing loop here once merged. :thumbsup:
